SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) AS nickname, u.phone_number AS phone, u.status AS status FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.role_key IN ('special_parent', 'special_teacher') WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id )
AND ( u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
